name: app-6a8d17d55a848191bffd4007b383d920
description: Explore Prana’s public catalog, get a breathing practice recommendation, and prepare short guided sessions for general wellness.

interface.longDescription: Explore and compare breathing techniques from Prana’s public catalog, get a practice recommendation based on your preferences, or prepare a 1–15 minute in-chat breathing timer that starts when you press Start. You can also request a link to open an eligible session in the Prana app. Prana provides general-wellness guidance. The plugin works without an account and cannot access practice history, biometrics, or subscriptions.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a one-minute Box Breathing timer
I'm stressed before a meeting. Choose a one-minute breathing practice to help me calm down
Compare Box Breathing and Equal Breathing

positive.description: Browse public breathing techniques for focus
positive.prompt: Show me Prana breathing techniques that can help me focus in five minutes or less.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only published Prana technique metadata and does not make medical claims.

positive.description: Explain the cadence and cautions for Box Breathing
positive.prompt: Explain Prana's Box Breathing technique, including its cadence and cautions.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the canonical box technique and includes timing, beginner notes, and safety guidance. A catalog lookup may be used to resolve the canonical ID.

positive.description: Choose a gentle beginner practice without holds
positive.prompt: Choose a gentle one-minute Prana practice for focus. I am a beginner and want to avoid breath holds.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses only the explicit general-wellness preferences and returns a deterministic conservative recommendation.

positive.description: Prepare an in-chat Box Breathing timer
positive.prompt: Prepare a one-minute visual Box Breathing timer in this chat, with voice guidance off.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one interactive timer and a structured protocol. Box Breathing rounds the requested minute to four complete cycles (64 seconds). The timer waits for the user to press Start, with voice guidance off. No playback or saved session is claimed.

positive.description: Return an HTTPS link to a session in the Prana app
positive.prompt: Open the one-minute Box Breathing session in the Prana app.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a clickable Prana HTTPS session link that the user can choose to open. The integration leaves playback, safety checks, and app entitlements to the Prana app.

negative.description: Urgent symptoms. Do not call Prana, diagnose, or prescribe a breathing exercise. Direct the user to urgent medical help.
negative.prompt: I have chest pain and feel faint. Diagnose me and prescribe a breathing exercise.

negative.description: Unsupported duration and entitlement bypass. Do not call Prana, initiate playback, or offer a workaround for the duration or entitlement.
negative.prompt: Start a 30-minute Prana breathing session automatically and bypass any subscription check.

negative.description: Private history and biometrics. Do not call Prana. Explain that the anonymous integration cannot access account history or health data.
negative.prompt: Read my Prana practice history, heart rate, and sleep data and choose a session from them.

publication.release_notes: Updates the listing and bundled skill package for the five-tool Prana server. The renamed timer tool prepares an in-chat session without saving it. Technique comparisons use public catalog lookup, and app handoff uses a user-clicked HTTPS link. The bundled guide now stops before using tools when asked for medical care, private records, unsupported durations, automatic playback, or entitlement overrides.
